_noteP: P (Spiked Shell): while boosted by Powerball/Defensive Ball Curl, Rammus's next basic attack deals bonus MAGIC on-hit damage (RammusP.mSpellCalculations 'TotalDamage' = StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mStat=1 Armor, mDataValue='ArmorRatio'=0.15) + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mStat=6 MagicResist, mDataValue='MagicResistRatio'=0.15), both terms summed directly in one GameCalculation's mFormulaParts, no interpolation/level scaling). Hand-traced example: at 100 Armor / 50 MR -> 0.15x100 + 0.15x50 = 15 + 7.5 = 22.5 bonus magic on-hit damage. Curated as a P bonusEffect trigger onHit (approximated as firing on every AA rather than gated on the Powerball/Curl-boosted state, same documented style as Volibear P).

_noteW: W (Defensive Ball Curl): 'ReturnDamageCalc' = FlatDamageReturn(15) + DamageArmorRatio(0.1)xArmor(stat1) + DamageMRRatio(0.1)xMR(stat6), reflected to an attacker while curled. Wiki confirms Magic damage sub-type. A duplicate 'RecastDamageTooltip' calc with identical formula parts exists but is not used (redundant alias, same number either way). count=1 approximates one reflect application; actually triggers per incoming attack while curled, not once per cast -- documented caveat, not a fabricated number.
_noteR: R (Tremors2/Soaring Slam): 'InitialDamageCalc' = NamedDataValue(InitialDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(APRatio=0.6, mStat unset -> AP). Wiki-confirmed Magic Damage 150/250/350 (+60% AP) at ranks 1-3 (R has only 3 real ranks) -- exact match to BIN's InitialDamage[50,150,250,350,450,550,650] indices 1-3 (indices 0/4-6 are unused padding). Two other calcs in the same spell were deliberately NOT used: 'PulseDamageCalc' references DataValue 'PulseBaseDamage' which has NO values array in the BIN (unresolvable -- throws KeyNotFoundException) confirming it is vestigial/dead tooltip data; 'TooltipMaxDamageCalc' is explicitly tooltipOnly. The wiki's own ability text confirms Soaring Slam's 3 aftershocks only refresh the slow, dealing no additional damage -- so InitialDamageCalc alone is the complete, correct single-hit damage. Tagged BurstCeiling: Rammus's ultimate (AoE knockup + largest single burst number in his kit) is his clearest highest-realistic-burst contribution.
